study: Independent before any candidate field, atlas, active rotor-shadow material or new images. This is comparative virtual daylight against existing original displayed 3D mesh, not a real-time turbine telemetry, measured outdoor flicker, or a ground-appearance study.
castScope: Exactly the already-installed NEAR submitted original spinner plus all three complete finite 3D blades, not a filled, planar, elliptical or averaged disk, static tower or other scene geometry. Literal instance matrix, backing Float32 position/index and per-instance regionalPhase. Freeze source vertices & release first; no new label data necessary. Original run-time object clock, modulo at 600, scalar Float32 phases and original shader angular coefficient; no second animation ticker or guessed wind. Use current ground mesh/epoch, not global ground Y or collidable height.
sourceInput: Independent extraction from actual released RegionalWind NEAR source batch after its normal update; do not use any prospective depth atlas, shadow stencil, source-caster ID from candidate, generated mask/internals or taught cutoffs as independent physical truth. Reconstruct shader YZ rotation and actual Three.Matrix4 in 3D from raw geometry. Cross-check direct positive Möller–Trumbore and complete projected-triangle raster with analytic positive solar ray. Reject if CPU methods disagree. Later read back actual GPU-bound rotor matrix/phase and clock, matched real renderer and real N112 terrain geometry. Compare source-held optical geometry to engine, not its own atlas.
stepping: These are absolute clock values not angular bins; source-seeded index i × original golden angle independently for each farm. The .619 to +1/60, 599.981 / 600 / 600.019 and complete 1200.173 return must follow signed original displayed silhouette to ≤0.03m geometric vertex error plus genuine one-frame time displacement (no phantom discontinuity, delayed 1-frame pose, quantized swaps or rotation in pause). Report same-time rendering repeated, plus advance/resume. Full-period error is not phase drift against real weather.

numericalPrereg.grid: Light-space Q=(X-Y*sun.x/sun.y,Z-Y*sun.z/sun.y). Anchor-relative qx=-15.937…150.1 qz=-26.063…111.1, pitch0.20m, independently shifted from any future depth map. Compute positive geometric depth and unrotated radial source attribution at every hit; do not use candidate support to trim denominator. Test all ±25/0m planes, two non-flat ±(.15,-.09),(-.12,.17) slope planes, above-source hub+radius+3m entirely empty, clipped high intermediate y=hub±.33radius (non-terrain stress, report separate). Also final N112 mounted arbitrary sloped terrain from all three reference regions. Strict hard positive = original positive ray intercept >.025m above receiver.
numericalPrereg.metric: Every family × clock × flat or slope phase: full three-blade+spinner hard silhouette IoU ≥.88, core recall ≥.97 for points inward ≥.55m, exterior specificity ≥.9995 more than .8m off shape and symmetric p95 contour deviation ≤.55m. Inspect every family separately. Outer 75–100% radii and each of 3 vanes must be nonempty and achieve ≥.75 recall at each of 8 primary times, never pooled to rescue missing tip or vane. Dense near-original geometry rather than all-negative sky. Any hard effect above original highest blade+.10m is a hard fail. If sources at part-overlap, measure their hard union and depth ordering rather than add. Report subpixel, strength/penumbra, clipped high stress and boundaries separately; never label soft partial-coverage hits as brightening or exact hard data.
numericalPrereg.solarExtent: Near shadow transitions may be penumbral only if bounded per actual source distance and base sun. Use .00465rad visible solar radius for soft-comparison, source-to-ground ray length/Dot(up,sun) projected to ground as appropriate (conservative 3D ray/ground tangent). Max tolerance .32m for documented receiver/atlas discretization plus true half pixel. No generic wide fade, no darkness from disk interior. Require ≥1% of full response is absent off actual finite three-dimensional solar+numerical support. Truth is around moving thin variable blades including tip, not around convex hull of rotor. Any discretization numbers are in metres.
numericalPrereg.staticEnergy: Original already-shaded static direct light is unchanged everywhere no rotor influences. At full existing static occlusion, rotor must not remove ambient/fog/specular or double-darken direct; compare true off/on against the source two-mask single-solar union. If implementation uses bounded max of soft fractions, do not call it the exact partial-area union. Extra effect never brightens at a fixed phase. No changes to meshes, materials, weather or sim timing to make a comparison pass.

liveControls.close: Ordinary 840×540 camera, true complete resident source geometry; two independent low directions (cross+reverse) per named rotor, fixed pre-appearance center is exact geometric spinner center projected by actual sun to flat ground. Compare .619 and 1.342 for each family from ≥1 direction, plus opposite direction in ≥1 area. Record original source rotor, matrix/phase and time and true N112 ray support in unchanged display. At least 100 ground pixels >2 source-specific per named family in at least one angle/phase and ≥60 truly dynamic changed ground pixels >2 between phase masks, not existing blade RGB movement, with no changes outside independent hard/solar-penumbral geometry plus two raster-AA pixels. On-off-on repeated after same tick must be exact. Never alter static-only shader counts or rotor visibility to manufacture delta. Counterfactual normal target off leaves real moving rotor and old tower shading active.
liveControls.negative: Warm-far 1025m/560m AGL camera at Eastern Kings, or all three if ambiguity; zero receiver changes /zero offscreen submits when outside declared reach. Cold unrelated Summerside, suspended/same normal-source clock, three existing nonterrain classes (true sky, maritime water, roof/aircraft/foliage whenever visible); verify exact original nonreceiver ID/depth or screen mask not just an RGB bbox. Darkening occurring on genuine opaque native ground under an alpha-tested tree is distinct from painting the tree. Aimed dry land results do not prove canopy/water physically cast. HCS9 retired/no ghost; all other 74 preserved correctly; North Cape existing separate light intact.
liveControls.capacity: Existing terrain correctness, 74 model roster / retired exclusion, canopy, existing static ground, collider, flight inputs and pass state must survive incapable device, compile/FBO/texture/asset failure, explicit stock, unload/re-entry and discontinuous epoch. At most +1 rotor caster pass/draw per visible active farm, +1 fragment sampler per actually active receiver, no global additional target/texture on cold/far or unused tile, no receiver mesh or triangles added. Original lower-cap near winds never disappear. Capture genuine draw counts INCLUDING offscreen, exact source triangles submitted (≤15200/9120/7600 east/west as assigned by original root roster: West15200, East9120, Hermanville7600), program fragment-only actual active sampler/vec4 counts, texture dimensions/byte allocation, cap and final framebuffer/viewport/scissor/color/depth state. No real hardware FPS from SwiftShader. Log measured frame timings paired, not GPU-time claims without a supported timer and matched conditions.
liveControls.adjacentAtlasSafeguard: Every live caster must have its own logically admitted source slot, no stale data after retirement/re-entry or wrong seed by compacted array, no atlas-border bleed, no missing shadow on adjacent visible ground tile. Retain numeric bounds across changing receiver Y and 12m eye-range hysteresis and the non-overlapping raw source layout. If exact old receiver height falls outside ±25m source stress, widen only after new fixed bounds or fail to static (do not clamp a real point into validated geography).

stop: Do not ship if real original rays, dynamic susceptibility, triangle budget, energy isolation, geographic safety, stable verified mount then static-only rollback, same renderer phase or visibly honest rotating silhouettes fail. Source plan is not renderer proof. The shown direction/yaw are project art, not measured real-position sunlight.
